prompt: A deployment needs AOF persistence with the standard trade-off between durability and speed. Which fsync policy is the default?
explanation: appendfsync everysec is the default: the AOF is fsynced about once per second, giving fast writes with at most roughly one second of acknowledged writes at risk after a crash. always fsyncs every command (slow, safest), and no leaves the timing to the operating system (fastest, least predictable).
